subject: Discovery recap & next steps — LunarHealth (timing check)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lunarhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — LunarHealth (timing check)

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap from our call so we have a single source of truth and can move to a short POC if you’re comfortable:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for clinical NLP ingestion while keeping 95th pct latency under 220ms for the routing microservice.
- Current signals: 2 x A100s in prod for batch processing, spikes during morning ingest windows (~9–11am PT).
- Success metrics for POC: 20% unit cost savings, latency <220ms 95th, no change to existing patient data retention policies.

Agreed next steps:
1) I’ll send a proposed POC scope + target success metrics (attached).
2) You’ll loop in procurement to confirm timing and any contractual constraints.
3) If timing looks good we’ll lock a two-week POC on a dedicated pool and SE will help with the onboarding.

Can you confirm preferred start window (Dec/Jan) and whether procurement needs an initial SOW or a standard PO? If Dec is aggressive on your side, we can target the first two weeks of Jan.

Attachment: LunarHealth-discovery-notes.txt

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lunarhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — LunarHealth (timing check)

Thanks, Sean — solid notes and thanks for the clear next steps. I’ll introduce procurement this week and aim to get alignment on timing. Jan window looks more realistic for us due to year-end freeze.

I’ll reply with the PO/contact once I hear back.

— Alex
Head of Architecture, LunarHealth
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lunarhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — LunarHealth (timing check)

Alex — quick follow to keep momentum. If Jan is best, would you be open to a kickoff week of Jan 11? We can reserve a small dedicated pool and have Dev join the first onboarding session to reduce friction on day one.

If you prefer I can loop in procurement directly with a short SOW and an initial ballpark for cost.

Thanks,
Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: no-reply from prospect — suggested play before next contact

Team — Alex acknowledged the plan on Dec 2 and said procurement would get back to us, but I haven’t heard anything since my Dec 8 follow-up. Before I send another external touch, wanted to align on the play and get SE/CS sign-off so we present a united front.

Proposed next action (short):
- External touch: single-line bump with two options: (1) confirm Jan 11 kickoff, (2) propose a 30-min technical workshop week of Jan 4 to lock onboarding dependencies. Framing = “helping unblock procurement / low-effort workshop”.
- SE ask (Dev): if we offer the workshop, can you cover the onboarding checklist + initial perf targets (30–45m)?
- CS ask (Monica): if we need to offer a one-time pilot credit (15% over two weeks) as a concession to shorten procurement cycles, are we ok? If legal needs to sign off on the credit, I can loop them in before contacting Alex.
- Leadership: if we want to prioritize this account into Q1 regional quota, Marissa — do you want a pricing exception or approve the pilot credit?

Why: LunarHealth has a tight HL7 integration and multiple ingest windows; getting SE into a low-effort workshop materially reduces friction and shortens procurement cycles.

Attachments: lunar-proposed-playbook-v1.md

If everyone is good, I’ll send an external bump this afternoon (short, not pushy) and mark the HubSpot deal as "contacted - re-engage" with a Jan 11 tentative kickoff.

Thanks — quick replies appreciated.
Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: no-reply from prospect — suggested play before next contact

Sean — sounds reasonable. Approve the 15% pilot credit for two weeks as a sales play to accelerate procurement, subject to legal review (I’ll ask them to look today).

Dev — please confirm availability for a 30–45m workshop week of Jan 4; if unavailable we can offer Jan 11 kickoff and have you on the onboarding call.

Monica — once legal confirms the credit, we’ll send the short SOW to procurement. Sean — go ahead and send the external bump after you get Dev’s confirmation.

Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
